data.narrative:
Fid Labs is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $1.7M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a sector universe of 9 private robotics and manufacturing companies plus 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), though narrow peer matching within robotics proved limited due to sparse same-stage and adjacent-stage data availability.

The stage-progression method was the primary applicable approach. Using the $1.7M total raised as a base proxy for $2M valuation, a standard seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $4.25M. The peer-median method could not be applied; while 10 robotics peers exist in the broader dataset, none of the same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier filters produced the minimum 3 comparable datapoints required for statistical reliability. A sector-wide median would introduce undue noise given stage and scale heterogeneity.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $3.6M to $4.9M, with a median of $4.25M. This narrow triangulation reflects the constraint of a single usable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of tighter peer benchmarks at seed stage within robotics manufacturing, and the wide variance in fundraising pace and valuation step-ups across the sector. Additional comparable data at adjacent stages or within manufacturing robotics subsegments would strengthen conviction in this range.
